Voluntary Account Closure and Reactivation

Document ID: SOP_C21_ACCOUNT_CLOSURE

Category: C21 — Termination & Deactivation

Department: Customer Care

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To standardise the closure of active connections and reactivation of connections deactivated for non-payment.

Procedure — Closure

Confirm all outstanding dues are cleared or scheduled for final settlement.

Process closure request; generate final pro-rated bill within 5-7 working days.

Place the number into the regulatory cooling-off period before recycling.

Procedure — Reactivation

Confirm the request is within the retention window (typically 90 days).

Clear outstanding dues and complete re-KYC if required.

Reactivate connection with original number where still held in cooling-off inventory.
